anchor: AIC's encoder graph prices a forward exactly by its total images: every factoring of N images into (batch, images-per-request) --- (1,64) or (64,1) --- returns the same latency to the microsecond, because attention is evaluated at the product batch×images and every other operator at the total token count.
claim_text: Encoder graph latency depends only on total images, not batch/images-per-request factoring; latency identical to microsecond.

adjudication.observed: Only N=64 has multiple factorizations: 7 tested, all predicted_ms = 316.369 ms with delta_vs_ref_ms = 0; N=1 has only one row at 8.162 ms.
adjudication.evidence: The database contains empirical backing only for multiple factorizations of N=64. The universal claim for 'every factoring of N images' is overclaimed as no other values of N are evaluated under multiple configurations.
adjudication.fix: Scope the claim specifically to N=64 images under the AIC cost model: all 7 tested factorizations produce exactly 316.369 ms with zero delta.
adjudication.query: SELECT probe_id, batch_size, images_per_request, total_images, predicted_ms, delta_vs_ref_ms FROM provenance.encoder_factoring_probe ORDER BY total_images, batch_size;

adjudication.observed: The probe has 8 rows across 2 totals; only N=64 has multiple factorizations: 7 pairs from (1,64) through (64,1), all 316.369 ms with maximum absolute delta 0 ms. N=1 has only (1,1) at 8.162 ms. Neither backing relation exposes current, superseded, or effective lifecycle columns.
adjudication.evidence: The DB establishes exact invariance only for the 7 tested factorizations of N=64; it does not establish the universal claim across N or the stated operator-level causal mechanism.
adjudication.fix: Scope the sentence to the probe: "For N=64 at 448 px, all seven tested factorizations from (1,64) to (64,1) returned the same AIC prediction, 316.369 ms (delta 0 ms)." Remove the causal explanation unless separately backed by implementation evidence.
adjudication.query:
WITH per_total AS (
  SELECT total_images,
         COUNT(*) AS tested_factorings,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (batch_size, images_per_request)) AS distinct_factorings,
         MIN(predicted_ms) AS min_predicted_ms,
         MAX(predicted_ms) AS max_predicted_ms,
         MAX(ABS(delta_vs_ref_ms)) AS max_abs_delta_ms,
         ARRAY_AGG('(' || batch_size || ',' || images_per_request || ')' ORDER BY batch_size) AS tested_pairs
  FROM provenance.encoder_factoring_probe
  GROUP BY total_images
), coverage AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS tested_totals,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE distinct_factorings > 1) AS totals_with_multiple_factorings,
         SUM(tested_factorings) AS probe_rows
  FROM per_total
), collector AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS valid_rows,
         MIN(aic_pred_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS min_aic_pred_ms,
         MAX(aic_pred_ms) FILTER (WHERE is_valid) AS max_aic_pred_ms
  FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn
  WHERE image_px = 448 AND n_images = 64
), lifecycle AS (
  SELECT table_name,
         ARRAY_AGG(column_name ORDER BY ordinal_position) FILTER (
           WHERE column_name IN ('is_current','is_superseded','superseded_by')
              OR column_name LIKE '%effective%'
         ) AS lifecycle_columns
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = 'provenance'
    AND table_name IN ('encoder_factoring_probe','collector_encoder_fn')
  GROUP BY table_name
)
SELECT p.total_images, p.tested_factorings, p.distinct_factorings,
       p.min_predicted_ms, p.max_predicted_ms, p.max_abs_delta_ms, p.tested_pairs,
       c.tested_totals, c.totals_with_multiple_factorings, c.probe_rows,
       e.valid_rows AS collector_valid_rows_n64,
       e.min_aic_pred_ms AS collector_min_aic_pred_ms_n64,
       e.max_aic_pred_ms AS collector_max_aic_pred_ms_n64,
       (SELECT lifecycle_columns FROM lifecycle WHERE table_name = 'encoder_factoring_probe') AS probe_lifecycle_columns,
       (SELECT lifecycle_columns FROM lifecycle WHERE table_name = 'collector_encoder_fn') AS collector_lifecycle_columns
FROM per_total p CROSS JOIN coverage c CROSS JOIN collector e
ORDER BY p.total_images
